_readme: Matt's live Flexmls subscriptions, for migration to the in-house alert engine.
WHY THIS FILE IS HAND-MAINTAINED: our Spark replication key is data-only.
not have permission to access this resource' (verified 2026-07-31), and the
Flexmls web UI sits behind a CAPTCHA. There is no programmatic export available
to us, so the definitions are transcribed here and imported by
SAFETY: the importer writes rows with is_active=false. Nothing sends until Matt
approves and the row is activated (--activate, or the account/admin UI). Alerts
to real recipients are an outbound-message class action under CLAUDE.md §1.
TO FINISH: add the remaining subscriptions from Flexmls (Contacts ->
Subscriptions). Per subscription capture: name, recipient email(s), the search
filters as our registry params, cadence, and which events are on.
filters use SEARCH FIELD REGISTRY param names (lib/search/field-registry.ts),
the same vocabulary the site URL uses, so an imported alert behaves exactly like
a saved search made on the site.
